lessons.note: skills.go helpers are pure: tokenize keeps only >=4-rune lowercased [a-z0-9] tokens (so 'api'/'the' drop) and dedups via a map; parseStringArray returns nil (not empty) on no-brackets/malformed/non-string-elements but a non-nil empty slice for '[]'; keywordSelect ranks by overlapping-token count desc and returns nil when nothing overlaps. No mocking needed — keyword fallback path is fully deterministic, unlike the LLM selector.
